title: Plant Factories Are Heating Up: lettuce growth dataset
creators: Esther Meinen, Laura Carotti, Luuk Graamans, Federico Puksic, Michele Butturini, Cecilia Stanghellini
conditions: Lactuca sativa cv. Batavia Othilie; Earth chambers; 16 h photoperiod; non-limiting water, nutrients and CO2. Four experiments, 2018–2019.
limitations: Tip-burn-related treatment omissions create selection bias.
Plant identifiers are reused across experiments; split by whole experiment.
